name: Dragon Chinese Cuisine
notes: Own site (address confirmed: 2169 Fenton Pkwy #102, San Diego 92108, Mission Valley). Static table-based site, footer copyright reads 2012 which is a staleness flag noted here since no better source could be checked (DoorDash 403'd WebFetch and Grubhub/UberEats listings were not readable). Captured all core menu pages: Appetizers, Soups, Egg Foo Young, Fried Rice, Chow Mein, Special Classic Entrees. Fried Rice and Chow Mein are priced by portion size (32oz/serves 1-2 up to 35-40 oz family trays); recorded at the smallest single-serving size only, larger family sizes available at higher prices not recorded here to avoid inflating the dish count with duplicates. Special Classic Entrees are a build-your-own format: price depends only on the chosen protein, and the customer separately picks one of 16 named sauces (Kung Pao, Mongolian Style, Black Bean, Black Pepper, Cashew, Broccoli, Sweet and Sour, Szechuan Style, Orange Flavored, Yellow Curry, Honey Flavored, Vegetable/Chop Suey, Snow Peas, General Tao's, Teriyaki, Salt & Pepper - sauce availability varies by protein); recorded as one item per protein tier rather than fabricating every sauce x protein combination. Excluded Entrees & Party Trays, Dragon Valu-Pak, Combo Party Trays and Special Combo Trays pages (bulk/catering pricing, not individual dishes). Categories reached: Appetizers, Soups, Egg Foo Young, Fried Rice, Chow Mein, Special Classic Entrees - complete for the individual-dish menu.
